At Commonwealth Dentistry in Mechanicsville, we do all we can to deliver you a smile you can be proud of. Our team of friendly Mechanicsville dentists and dental professionals offer the latest treatments and are dedicated to providing outstanding care in a comfortable environment. We are so excited to be joining the community to help bring healthy smiles to Mechanicsville!

We offer comprehensive general, cosmetic, and restorative treatments in-office, ensuring that no matter what you face on your dental journey, you can always get the care you need from a dental team you trust.
Our Mechanicsville dentistry services include:
We accept most major insurance plans as well as many regional plans. For those without insurance, take advantage of our in-house discount plan.
At Commonwealth Dentistry, you always come first. Our appointments always start on time and exceed expectations.
Our Mechanicsville dentist office offers comprehensive general and cosmetic treatments and works with other Commonwealth locations to provide specialty treatment.
Are you experiencing a dental emergency? We offer same-day visits to get you back to feeling like yourself.

Grant H. Shaw, DDS, is a native of Beaverdam, VA, in Hanover County, and a proud graduate of Patrick Henry High School in Ashland, VA. His journey into dentistry began in 9th grade while shadowing a family friend who was a dentist. Dentistry captivated him because it combines fine hand skills, science, artistry, engineering, and health care, allowing him to improve smiles, alleviate pain, and enhance confidence and quality of life.

Dr. Shaw completed his undergraduate studies at the University of Virginia in Charlottesville, VA, and earned his dental degree from Virginia Commonwealth University in Richmond, VA. In his practice, Dr. Shaw is dedicated to transforming people’s perception of the “dentist” by providing positive, anxiety-free appointments. He focuses on relieving pain, restoring smiles, and enhancing patients’ confidence and quality of life.

Outside of work, Dr. Shaw enjoys spending time with his wife, Melissa, exploring the outdoors. He loves fishing, hunting, hiking, boating, and traveling to the beach, lake, and river. He also enjoys golfing with friends, playing tennis, watching sports, and discovering new restaurants and cuisines. Dr. Shaw is excited to serve the Hanover community that helped raise him.
